The map used in that final paragraph is the original truncation t:E→T on X, where T^a=E^a/B^a, T^j=E^j for a<j≤b, and T is zero elsewhere. Its component in degree a is the quotient map, its higher components are identities, and its lower components are zero. The preceding assertion makes t a quasi-isomorphism. Tensoring t with an arbitrary h^{-1}O_S-module therefore identifies the cohomology used to test toramp_h(E) with that of T. The terms T^j for j>a are h-flat because they are locally free over O_X and h is flat. LemmaI5.1.1, with m=a,n=b,F=T and base h^{-1}O_S, then gives precisely the h-flatness of T^a claimed at the start of256. The intervening fibre comparison has objects over the residue fibre and supplies no such map E→T on X. Therefore repair the later reference(*) to(t), and remove the previously inserted(*) label from the headless fibre comparison. The printed t) and i*(t) labels themselves remain unchanged.
